entries.rationale: Only changed case is result.Count=2000. RemoveRange(2000,0) is valid and changes no list contents. No enumerator or version is exposed; the result is copied into a new array.

Private generation is observed solely by equality against a snapshot. Incrementing or decrementing once per Cancel preserves exactly the same equality relation over any number of operations modulo64bit wraparound. No generation value or ordering is exposed.
Only changed case is itemCount=0. For columns<=0 both return0 via the second guard; for positive columns the expression (columns-1)/columns is0 and cannot overflow. Both return the same result.
